messages:
alex: Heads-up — console alert: fncall validation rejects spiked to 0.9% in us-west-2 over the last hour. Mostly routes using openapi-style tool adapters. Anyone seeing this?

sara: saw the spike, grabbing samples now. lots of partial/quoted-json returns like `"[\"{\\\"temp\\\":70}\"]"` and arrays when we expect an object.

mike: example payload I'm seeing in logs: 
```json
{
  "tool": "weather",
  "response": "[{\"temp\":70}]"
}
```
that string-escaped array trips the validator.

lina: cause looks like adapter shim that `stringify()`s responses for legacy clients. validator.validate_fncall is strict and emits `fncall.schema.reject` metric.

alex: quick product/ops q: do we want to 1) relax the validator (per-route permissive mode) 2) convert adapter behavior, or 3) handle coercion at runtime with a best-effort parsing pass?

jm: +1 to preserving correctness. operationally we need better observability first — current reject metric is opaque. proposal: attach `rejection_code` and `trace_id` to the telemetry event so we can correlate to request logs and adapter versions. also include a sampled `raw_payload_snippet` (redacted).

kat: UX: how would this show up in Console? We shouldn't dump raw JSON. want: time series of rejects, top failing routes, and 1-3 redacted samples per bucket. also flag impacted customers.

ops-bot: Deploy: started canary of `permissive-fncall-validator:v2` on 10% of traffic to `openapi-*` adapters.

sara: implementation note: current validator throws away original payload on error. we'll need to keep a tiny buffer (<=512 bytes) and run redaction before emitting. PII guard rails needed.

mike: suggested telemetry event shape (pseudocode):
```json
{
  "event": "fncall_reject",
  "rejection_code": "TYPE_MISMATCH",
  "route": "/v1/tools/weather",
  "adapter_version": "openapi-adapter@1.4.2",
  "trace_id": "abc123",
  "sampled_payload": "{\"response\": \"[REDACTED]\"}",
  "sampling_rate": "0.01"
}
```

jm: important: sampling and redaction rules must live in the validator so we don't leak secrets to downstream telemetry. keep sampling config remote-toggleable.

lina: about quotas/billing — currently we bill token usage even when fncall is rejected because the user request reached runtime. Do we want to bill for strict schema rejects? customers will complain if they keep getting charged for bad adapter responses.

alex: product preference is not to surprise customers. proposal: treat `fncall` validation rejects as non-billable for hosted API (don't count toward billed tokens), but still count toward rate limits/quotas for abuse protection. open to pushback.

kat: edge case: if permissive-coercion accepts a response but coerces data (e.g., array -> object), should we bill? I'd argue yes if we return a success to the customer.

mike: operationally we can have three outcomes: `REJECT` (no bill), `COERCE_SUCCESS` (bill), `FALLBACK` (depends — if fallback uses another model or external call bill accordingly). need to encode this in telemetry.

alex: rollout plan: 1) Add rejection_code + trace_id to telemetry (sprint 1) 2) add sampled redacted payload (sprint 1) 3) Console: new panel showing rejects, top routes, adapter versions (sprint 2) 4) Billing policy change: treats REJECTs as non-billable behind an enterprise flag (sprint 2 canary) 5) Long term: encourage adapter change.

jm: I'll own telemetry + sampling. sara/mike you two pair on validator changes. lina/ops coordinate canary. kat will draft Console mockups. alex will sync with billing for policy.

alex: also: small runtime enhancement idea — add `validation_meta` to the fncall response envelope when we do `COERCE_SUCCESS` so SDKs can surface what was coerced. e.g., `validation_meta: {coerced_fields: ["location"]}`. that helps customers debug adapter issues without raw payloads.

sara: agree. sdk teams warned that adding fields can break strict clients; make it opt-in via `X-Include-Validation-Meta` header.

mike: one last ops note: add a durable log for rejects to the infra-indexed store (retention 30d) so we can run batch regressions. sensitive fields redacted at ingest.

alex: perfect. action items assembled. requeue for standup tomorrow for status updates. :thumbsup:
